policy.scores: 0-100; higher is better except securityRisk where higher is worse

candidates.purpose: official REST/WebSocket/SSE market-data and paper-trading SDK
candidates.docsTests: official SDK with documentation/examples; runtime model validation
candidates.dataRequirements: Alpaca account/API keys; feed entitlements and plan determine coverage/latency
candidates.securityNotes: keys must remain in secrets; never expose broker permissions to frontend; market-data and trading credentials should be separated
candidates.biasNotes: stream events are suitable for live features; replay must preserve event timestamps and avoid consolidated-bar look-ahead
candidates.nextTest: sandbox StockDataStream adapter benchmark for trade/quote arrival latency and disconnect recovery before any production dependency

candidates.purpose: SEC EDGAR filing retrieval by ticker/CIK
candidates.docsTests: README documents fair-access user-agent, broad filing support, unit/integration/lint/doc test flows
candidates.dataRequirements: public SEC EDGAR; requires compliant user-agent and rate discipline
candidates.securityNotes: low privilege; validate downloaded content and isolate parser from untrusted HTML
candidates.biasNotes: filing acceptance/publish timestamp must be stored and used as event time; do not use later amended content at earlier replay timestamps
candidates.nextTest: benchmark 8-K/6-K/S-1/S-3/424B/144 freshness and ticker mapping against current SEC pipeline; promote only if recall improves without SEC rate failures

candidates.purpose: multi-provider financial data platform and agent-facing data normalization patterns
candidates.maintenance: active large project; repo updated 2026-08-26, pushed 2026-07-30
candidates.docsTests: large documented platform with provider extension architecture
candidates.dataRequirements: varies by provider; many useful feeds require external credentials/subscriptions
candidates.securityNotes: large dependency surface; provider credentials and extension supply-chain require strict sandboxing
candidates.biasNotes: normalization can obscure source timestamp semantics; preserve raw provider timestamps alongside normalized values
candidates.nextTest: borrow provider-adapter/result-standardization pattern only; do not add full dependency to TAGX

candidates.purpose: vectorized event/backtest experimentation and parameter sweeps
candidates.license: NOASSERTION in GitHub metadata; review repository license before use
candidates.docsTests: mature backtesting ecosystem; suited to offline parameter sweeps rather than live ingestion
candidates.dataRequirements: data agnostic; quality depends entirely on supplied event history
candidates.biasNotes: high look-ahead risk if intraperiod features are reconstructed from final bars; only use timestamped snapshots/events
candidates.nextTest: prototype replay metrics externally; no production dependency until license and timestamp semantics are verified
